_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution: a mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so `s.stdio.semio.animation`'s oracle registration and catalog live here rather than in a shared manifest. `s.stdio.semio.animation` is a semio-NATIVE format, so its reference is a second IMPLEMENTATION written in another language from the committed grammars rather than a third-party package.

oracles.rationale: No third-party library in any ecosystem reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio` envelope, so the second producer THE STANDARD requires is a second IMPLEMENTATION in another language. `../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-semio-animation/🐍️component.py` is that implementation: the `semio <envelope-id>.dsl v1` preamble, the whole `document = artifact-mark schema-line timelines-line` grammar in both directions — `timeline`, `option-name`, `channel`, `target`, `property = t|r|s|w|c:<hex>`, `interpolation = l|s|c`, `keyframe` and `value = S|V|Q|W` included — and all thirteen verbs of this subset's vocabulary together with their inverses, written in Python from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/📝️text/📖️component.grammar.semio`, `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/📝️text/📖️component.grammar.semio` and the envelope section of `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🧬️semio/🦀️component.rs`, importing nothing from and transliterating nothing of the Rust it judges. Two leaves the grammar states by reference were settled from its own notes and pinned by byte-exact re-emission: `hex` is the framework macro, so `77616c6b` is `walk` and `6f706163697479` is `opacity`, and `number = INT | FLOAT` prints through Rust's `{v}` Display, which drops the fractional part of an integral value — the committed walk cycle carries both spellings. `package` is deliberately the empty string: the implementation needs no distribution, so it contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json` and nothing to the import-purity probe. The interchange-reader route was surveyed again and still rejected on the merits rather than for absence — `gif` 0.13 exposes per-frame delays alone, and `pygltflib`/`gltf-transform` judge glTF's `channel` + `sampler` accessor indirection while this snapshot resolves that model into owned keyframes, so nine of the thirteen kinds would have had nothing to compare against.
